propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes, with vendor payloads crossing core solely as opaque payloads at port boundaries (InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local and OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote).
All Jira vendor modules must be physically relocated under adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims, and transport construction must route exclusively through select_backend().

Package-root reconciler modules must have zero vendor reach-through: no adapters.jira imports, no lazy-key literals for vendor paths, and no by-path loads of vendor modules (with single exemption for inbound_fields.py pending follow-up relocation).

The outbound differ, link differ, absence probe, and rich-text/comment-limit paths must be brought to canonical-comparison parity by injecting vendor mappers through the backend port rather than extending the port interface with vendor-shaped helpers.
